chapter_conditions.text: This Chapter does not cover: (a) worn headgear of heading 6309; (b) asbestos headgear (heading 6812); or (c) dolls’ hats, other toy hats or carnival articles of Chapter 95.
Heading 6502 does not cover hat-shapes made by sewing, other than those obtained simply by sewing strips in spirals.
